entry: Run folder created and the frozen code staged: Glymph 0.3.0 with the exclusion constraint, per-cell multipliers, the cell-total output rule, false-positive budget 0.4%.

All 54 usable libraries were ready (the four read-based species mixtures aligned and ingested at 22:19), so every tool was launched on every tier: Glymph at four false-positive budgets, CellBender at three from one training run, SoupX, DecontX with and without background, scAR; scoring and collection chained after them. AmbiDose is left out: it failed on libraries above about 9,000 cells in the first run.

Resource tests launched beside it: all libraries on one 4-GPU node, Glymph on CPU only (three library sizes), Glymph and CellBender on a library tiled 1 to 8 times, Glymph on a V100 and an A100. The gpu32 partition (RTX6000, L40S) refused the lab GPU account (it asks for a GPU32 account), so those two GPU models are not tested.

Two SoupX and DecontX tasks failed loading R packages from the shared filesystem when 48 started together (three retries were not enough). A second pass, eight at a time, fills in only the missing outputs (59730489); scoring now waits for it.
Scoring and collection finished (59730213, 59730214). Every tool produced an output for every library; the 14 failed tasks of the first SoupX and DecontX pass were filled by the second.

Last resource job done (CellBender on 160,000 cells, 4 h 29 min, 112 GB RAM). Glymph failed at 80,000 and 160,000 cells with a GPU out-of-memory error in the silent-gene calibration, which gathered every entry of the confident cells at once. Recorded as a Glymph failure; fix and rerun go to the next run.

Parse mixtures: every tool removed about 20% of cross-species counts. Cause found in the raw data: 68% of mouse counts in human cells are on Gm42418 and 10% on Lars2, at the same level in wells that held only human cells, so they are ribosomal RNA reads aligned to the wrong genome and not RNA from another cell. The species scorer now masks such genes by a rule that uses raw counts only (at least 0.5% of a species' cross-species counts, more than ten times the gene's share in the other species' cells and in the soup), for every tool alike; the unmasked scores are kept in scores_species_unmasked.tsv. This changes the scoring rule after seeing results, so both versions are reported.

Rescoring done (59741221, 59741222). Masked genes: Gm42418, Lars2, AY036118, RNA18S5, RNA28S5 and an unplaced rRNA-like gene across platforms; PLCG2 in the nuclei barnyard and Parse; human IL6 and CSF1 in the xenograft mice, which carry those transgenes. Run closed; Glymph 0.3.0 stays as scored and the fixes are developed in 20261117-0544_glymph-031-dev.
